title: Public Health Analytics-OS observation and reference-value layer
ingestionGate: Canonical indicator or data-element identity resolves in the unified registry
Geographic or reporting-unit identity and reporting period are explicit
Source version, retrieval date, acquisition method and lineage are recorded
Unit and scale agree with the governed definition
Disaggregations retain source labels and codes where available
Revision and replacement history are explicit
Privacy, disclosure and suppression rules pass before public publication
Licensing and redistribution rights permit the intended access class
prohibitedContent: Values without a resolvable subject definition
Observed results embedded into indicator definitions
interpretationBoundary: This manifest publishes an ingestion contract, not health data. Zero aggregate observations and zero reference values are included. Structural conformance will not by itself establish source authority, comparability, data quality, privacy clearance or fitness for analysis.
